children: The veteran corporate lawyer will serve a five-year term starting September 17, 2026

Vodafone Idea has appointed Gopika Pant as an Additional Director, qualifying as an Independent Woman Director on the company’s Board, following a recommendation from its Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Pant will assume the role on September 17, 2026, for a five-year term. She brings more than four decades of legal experience across corporate, commercial and regulatory matters.
For the past 10 consecutive years, Pant has been recognised in the ‘A’ List of India’s top 100 lawyers by the India Business Law Journal, Hong Kong.

Her legal experience spans Indian corporate and commercial law, including cross-border transactions such as mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and business alliances. She has also advised on private equity investments and exits, information technology, banking and finance, non-banking finance companies, corporate restructuring, real estate transactions, foreign investments into India and outbound investments from India.
Her areas of expertise further include labour and employment and intellectual property law.

Pant was made a partner at one of India’s leading law firms before founding Indian Law Partners (ILP) in 1999. She has also featured in the Forbes India Legal Powerlist 2020 and 2021 as one of the Top Managing Partners in India.
Her appointment comes as Vodafone Idea strengthens the composition of its Board with legal expertise spanning corporate governance, investments, cross-border transactions and regulatory matters.
